name: DSC evaluation (mask - mask)
summary: Computes Dice similarity, Jaccard, sensitivity and TP/FP/FN between corresponding bundles in two collections of tract masks (estimated vs ground truth) using nibabel.
description: For every bundle mask in the ground-truth collection, loads the mask with the same name from the estimated collection and computes voxel overlap scores, one row per bundle in a CSV. Use it to evaluate a bundle segmentation against a reference of the same subject. Both collections must contain masks with the same file names in the same voxel grid; the App stops if the subject IDs differ or the two inputs are identical. WMC bundles can first be converted to masks with brainlife.app.142.

inputs.description: a collection of estimated bundle masks
inputs.requirements: Same subject as the ground truth; mask file names must match those of the ground truth collection.

inputs.description: a collection of ground truth bundle masks
inputs.requirements: Same subject and voxel grid as the estimated masks.

outputs.description: .csv file with the following scores: DSC, J, sensitivity, TP, FP, FN

citations.text: Dice, L. R. Measures of the amount of ecologic association between species. Ecology 26(3):297-302 (1945).
Avesani P. et al. The open diffusion data derivatives, brain data upcycling via integrated publishing of derivatives and reproducible open cloud services. Sci Data 6, 69 (2019).

failure_modes.message: Error: estimated segmentation and ground truth segmentation are the same. DSC will be 1.
failure_modes.fix: Select a different ground truth collection.

failure_modes.message: Inputs subject IDs incorrectly inserted. Check them again.
failure_modes.fix: Use inputs from the same subject.
